title: Iliotibial Band
note: Generated by tools/figures.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification and source fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. A figure the reviewer corrects or deletes is marked REMOVED rather than removed from this file.

figures.claim: In extension it lies in front of the axis of rotation and helps extend; past about 30 degrees it lies behind and helps flex.
Conventional teaching gives the band a width at the knee of the order of 25 mm superficially, narrowing as it approaches its tibial attachment.
